prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 162 and 195 Kimi tokens; aim for 178 tokens to match the source. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: The tar archive file at tar_path and its listed members.
TRUST: dest_path is trusted; all archive contents are untrusted external input.
SINK: Filesystem paths resolved under dest_path for created regular files and directories.
GUARD: Reject every symbolic-link and hard-link member, including links whose declared targets appear to remain inside the destination; regular files and directories may still be extracted after validation, provided their resolved absolute path is strictly within dest_path.
ORDER: Open the archive; iterate members; validate each by rejecting links and paths that normalize outside dest_path; abort and return False on any validation or extraction failure; extract all validated regular files and directories; return True on complete success.
EFFECT: Returns True only if every non-link member is extracted under dest_path; otherwise returns False without creating any link or writing any member outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
